'''Team Warscythe''' was a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:KIT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Team Warscythe assisted [[Havoc Squadron]] during a mission to capture an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] transporting an Imperial technician involved in the construction of a new Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Karthakk system]]. The Rebel force attacked the Imperial convoy in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. While Team Warscythe boarded the Imperial [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of Havoc Squadron destroyed the escort of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE aggressors]]. The commandos finally succeeded in taking control of the shuttle and kidnap the technician. Havoc Squadron then provided escort to the captured ''Lambda'' shuttle until the commando reached the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point and left the system.<ref name="SWG:KIT" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Team Warscythe was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KIT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Team Warscythe was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:KIT" />
